items.source: NOTE: In general, do not inject EXTENDED EntityManagers into STATELESS beans, i.e. do not use @PersistenceContext with type EXTENDED in Spring beans defined with scope 'singleton' (Spring's default scope). Extended EntityManagers are not thread-safe, hence they must not be used in concurrently accessed beans (which Spring-managed singletons usually are).
items.translation: 注意：通常不要将扩展的实体管理器注入到无状态 Bean 中，即不要在定义为 'singleton'（Spring 默认作用域）的 Spring Bean 中使用类型为 EXTENDED 的 @PersistenceContext。 扩展的实体管理器不是线程安全的，因此不能在并发访问的 Bean 中使用（Spring 管理的单例通常属于此类）。

items.source: This post-processor will inject sub-interfaces of EntityManagerFactory and EntityManager if the annotated fields or methods are declared as such. The actual type will be verified early, with the exception of a shared ("transactional") EntityManager reference, where type mismatches might be detected as late as on the first actual invocation.
items.translation: 此后置处理器将在注解的字段或方法声明为相应类型时，注入 EntityManagerFactory 和 EntityManager 的子接口。实际类型将尽早进行验证，但共享（“事务性”）EntityManager 引用除外，其类型不匹配可能直到第一次实际调用时才被发现。

items.source: This post-processor can either obtain EntityManagerFactory beans defined in the Spring application context (the default), or obtain EntityManagerFactory references from JNDI ("persistence unit references"). In the bean case, the persistence unit name will be matched against the actual deployed unit, with the bean name used as fallback unit name if no deployed name found. Typically, Spring's LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean will be used for setting up such EntityManagerFactory beans. Alternatively, such beans may also be obtained from JNDI, for example, using the jee:jndi-lookup XML configuration element (with the bean name matching the requested unit name). In both cases, the post-processor definition will look as simple as this:
items.translation: 此后置处理器可以获取 Spring 应用程序上下文中定义的 EntityManagerFactory Bean（默认方式），或者从 JNDI 获取 EntityManagerFactory 引用（“持久化单元引用”）。在 Bean 的情况下，持久化单元名称将与实际部署的单元进行匹配；如果未找到已部署的名称，则使用 Bean 名称作为后备单元名称。通常，将使用 Spring 的 LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean 来设置此类 EntityManagerFactory Bean。或者，也可以从 JNDI 获取此类 Bean，例如使用 jee:jndi-lookup XML 配置元素（其中 Bean 名称与请求的单元名称匹配）。在这两种情况下，后置处理器的定义都将非常简单，如下所示：

items.source: Note: In the present implementation, PersistenceAnnotationBeanPostProcessor only supports @PersistenceUnit and @PersistenceContext with the "unitName" attribute, or no attribute at all (for the default unit). If those annotations are present with the "name" attribute at the class level, they will simply be ignored, since those only serve as deployment hint (as per the Jakarta EE specification).
items.translation: 注意：在当前实现中，PersistenceAnnotationBeanPostProcessor 仅支持带有 "unitName" 属性或没有任何属性（用于默认单元）的 `@PersistenceUnit` 和 `@PersistenceContext`。如果在类级别存在带有 "name" 属性的这些注解，它们将被直接忽略，因为这些注解仅作为部署提示（根据 Jakarta EE 规范）。

items.source: If no corresponding "persistenceContexts"/"extendedPersistenceContexts" are specified, @PersistenceContext will be resolved to EntityManagers built on top of the EntityManagerFactory defined here. Note that those will be Spring-managed EntityManagers, which implement transaction synchronization based on Spring's facilities. If you prefer the Jakarta EE server's own EntityManager handling, specify corresponding "persistenceContexts"/"extendedPersistenceContexts".
items.translation: 如果未指定相应的 "persistenceContexts"/"extendedPersistenceContexts"，@PersistenceContext 将解析为基于此处定义的 EntityManagerFactory 构建的 EntityManagers。请注意，这些是由 Spring 管理的 EntityManagers，它们实现了基于 Spring 设施的事务同步。如果您更喜欢 Jakarta EE 服务器自身的 EntityManager 处理，请指定相应的 "persistenceContexts"/"extendedPersistenceContexts"。
